name: Angler Lorna

intro.text: The Irthing runs fast and cold, and the salmon run it every autumn. Today the salmon are doing better than me.

win: Fair play. I'll go back to the other end of the river.
after: A salmon will go back to the river it was born in, years later, and leap a weir to do it. I couldn't get back to my own birthplace if there was a bus.
